rationale: The plan matches the reference: a DESeq2 LRT of ~ condition + time + condition:time against ~ condition + time as the primary joint interaction test, with per-time-point simple effects (ashr-shrunk, since they are multi-coefficient contrasts) describing the pattern, plus an edgeR QL cross-check on identical input. Reference levels, the reduced model, median-of-ratios inside the model, and a minimal 10-counts-in-3-samples filter are all explicit and justified; BH at alpha 0.05 is passed to results with independent filtering. QC covers blind-vst PCA and a distance heatmap colored by condition and time with a library-size check, though the outlier policy is only 'report as a finding' rather than a stated decision rule. Enrichment is correctly omitted, and the report specification covers method, versions, design, thresholds, tested/significant counts, power and length-offset caveats, and a reproducibility record.
